scan.title: Scan Products from Photo
scan.lede: Take a photo of your supplier invoice, price list, or menu board. Names, prices, and units are filled in automatically — you just review and save.
scan.tip1: Shoot from directly above, not at an angle
scan.tip2: Make sure there is enough light, avoid shadows
scan.tip3: Long invoice? Take it in sections instead of zooming out
scan.processingDesc: This takes 10–30 seconds depending on your connection. Please keep this page open.
scan.offlineDesc: Photo scanning runs on the server, so it cannot work offline. The cashier and other product features still work normally.
scan.disabledDesc: Photo scanning is not enabled on this server. For now you can add products manually or import from Excel.
scan.unreadableDefault: No products could be read from this photo
scan.unreadableHelp: Try getting closer, make sure there is enough light, and shoot from above. This attempt did not use up your quota.
scan.quotaHelp: Your quota resets at the start of next month. In the meantime you can still add products manually or via Excel.
scan.genericError: Failed to process the photo. Please try again.
scan.notAnImage: The file must be an image
scan.fileTooLarge: The photo is still too large after compression
scan.loginDesc: Photo scanning runs on the Kan POS server, so you need to sign in with your Google account first. Adding products manually and importing from Excel still work without signing in.
scan.timeoutError: Reading the photo took too long and was stopped
scan.timeoutHelp: Your connection may be slow, or there are too many photos. Try again with fewer photos. This attempt did not use up your quota.
scan.busyHelp: This is an issue with the reading service, not your quota — no quota was used. Try again in a few minutes, or add products manually for now.
scan.unavailableHelp: Photo scanning is unavailable on the server right now. Contact your admin if this continues.

speech.title: Add Products by Voice
speech.readyTitle: Say your products one by one
speech.readyDesc: Name first, then cost and selling price. Up to {{seconds}} seconds — enough for about 8 products.
speech.recordingDesc: Say “next” between products. Tap the button when you are done.
speech.levelOk: Your voice is coming through clearly
speech.levelLow: Too quiet — hold the phone closer
speech.processingDesc: Takes 5–15 seconds. Do not close this page.
speech.listeningDesc: Say the products one by one. The text appears below — if something is misheard, just repeat that sentence.

retail: Indomie goreng, cost two thousand five hundred, sell three thousand, stock two boxes
Next, Aqua six hundred ml, cost three thousand, sell five thousand
wholesale: Gulaku sugar one kilo, cost thirteen thousand, sell fifteen thousand
Next, cooking oil two litres, cost thirty two thousand, sell thirty five thousand
resto: Special fried rice twenty five thousand
Next, fried noodles twenty three thousand, iced sweet tea five thousand

speech.tip1: Say “cost” and “sell” — not just one number
speech.tip2: Say “next” or pause briefly between products
speech.tip3: If it is noisy, hold the phone closer
speech.quotaLeft: {{remaining}} of {{limit}} AI uses left this month
speech.offlineDesc: Your voice is processed on the server, so this does not work offline. Cashier and other product features still work normally.
speech.loginDesc: Voice product entry is processed on Kan POS servers, so you need to sign in with Google first. Adding products manually still works without signing in.
speech.disabledDesc: Voice product entry is not enabled on this server yet. For now you can add products manually, by photo, or via Excel.
speech.deniedDesc: Microphone permission was denied. Turn it on in your phone settings, then try again. Recording only happens while you hold the record button, and is never stored.
speech.unsupportedDesc: No microphone was detected. You can still add products by photo, Excel, or manually.
speech.unheardDefault: No products could be picked up from this recording
speech.unheardHelp: Try holding the phone closer and saying the name along with the price. This attempt did not use your quota.
speech.timeoutError: Processing took too long and was stopped
speech.timeoutHelp: The network may be slow. Try again with a shorter recording. This attempt did not use your quota.
speech.genericError: Failed to process the recording. Try again.
